identification: Box of about 13 Fleming and related Bond books, one photo. Visible spines: Colonel Sun (Markham/Amis, Cape 1968, faded blue jacket), Nobody Lives Forever (Gardner, modern jacket), Casino Royale (Penguin paperback), Dr No and Goldfinger (cream jackets, publisher unconfirmed), On Her Majesty's Secret Service and Man With the Golden Gun (TBC Book Club monogram), Live and Let Die (pictorial jacket, probably Book Club), black cloth O.H.M.S.S. with gilt initials and Cape urn (no jacket), For Your Eyes Only (Chopping eye jacket, publisher unconfirmed), Licence Renewed (BCA). A box note reads '144 James Bond 007 by Ian Fleming'. Jackets look toned and chipped. Most of the set looks like Book Club copies, worth a few dollars each. Value rests on Cape colonel Sun (about $60-150), jacketless Cape OHMSS (about $30-60) and any Dr No, Goldfinger or FYEO that is truly Cape first impression in jacket ($300-600 each in good state, much less when worn).

chrome_hint: eBay sold/completed: 'Ian Fleming Book Club edition dust jacket lot' and 'Colonel Sun Robert Markham first edition dust jacket'; also WorthPoint 'Colonel Sun Jonathan Cape 1968'
viewing_check: Open each hardback to the copyright page and check: Cape 'First published 19xx' with no 'Reprinted' line and printed 'Jonathan Cape' on jacket flap price (e.g. Dr No 15s, Goldfinger 15s, FYEO 16s) vs 'The Book Club' on the copyright page or no price on flap. Prioritise Dr No, Goldfinger, For Your Eyes Only, Live and Let Die and Colonel Sun. Check the black O.H.M.S.S. title page and imprint date (Cape 1963 first would be worth keeping; check for 'First published 1963'). Photograph jackets front and back, note price clipping and any library marks. Check if any copy is signed.
